title: Saving a tracked part without a bin or default bin shows an error
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Parts -> Inventory page on the build under test, with permission to view inventory parts.
  2. You hold "Part Library & Inventory - Create & Edit". Open New Inventory Part with tracking ON.
custom_steps:
1. Try to save with no bin location assigned; read the message.
  2. Assign bin locations but mark none as default; try to save and read the message.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Saving a tracked part with no bin location shows "At least one bin must be provided."
  • Saving with bin locations but none marked default shows "At least one bin must be marked as default."

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; "Parts Lifecycle Update" PRD (Confluence 829227015, IN REVIEW 2026-09-09), Story 4 (Create an untracked part); design canvas Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026 against an IN-REVIEW spec; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-N1: “If the user attempts to save a tracked part with no bin location assigned, the system displays: "At least one bin must be provided."”
  • S4-N2: “If the user assigns bin locations but none is marked as the default, the system displays: "At least one bin must be marked as default."”
